snippet.title: Junk Runner 64 - N64brew Game Jam 2025 Submission
snippet.description:
Created by: Team Ultrarare (lambertjamesd, Pyroxene, SapphireOnze, beta_dynast, terzdesign)

Recommended to be played on hardware. If you wish to play on an emulator, ares is recommended: https://ares-emu.net/

Download and Source Code can be found in the N64brew Discord: 
https://discord.com/invite/WqFgNWf

Also available on GitHub: https://github.com/N64brew-Game-Jam-2025/Junkrunner64
